query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN transportadora IS NULL OR transportadora = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sem_transportadora,
  SUM(CASE WHEN representante IS NULL OR representante = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sem_representante,
  SUM(CASE WHEN segmento IS NULL OR segmento = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sem_segmento,
  SUM(CASE WHEN crmSegmento IS NULL OR crmSegmento = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sem_crm_segmento,
  SUM(CASE WHEN condicaoPagamento IS NULL OR condicaoPagamento = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sem_cond_pagamento
FROM sales_orders;
